# Task P8-04: Library page — filters, selection and the mass editor, tags, saved views

**Phase:** 8 · **Depends on:** P8-03 (merged; the API exists) · **Delegate:** sonnet subagent · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
The Library page (`frontend/src/pages/LibraryPage.tsx`) becomes the place to manage many songs at once, like Lidarr's mass editor: filter on the server, select rows (one, a range, all on the page), change monitored / quality profile / library / tags for the selection, delete the selection, and save the current filters as a named view to come back to. The API is P8-03's (read `docs/build/tasks/P8-03.md` and the merged controllers): `GET /api/v1/song` with `term`, `monitored`, `hasFile`, `cutoffMet`, `libraryId`, `qualityProfileId`, `qualityId`, `tag`, `artistId` and the sort keys `title`, `artist`, `album`, `added`, `quality`, `monitored`, `library`; `PUT /api/v1/song/editor`; `DELETE /api/v1/song/editor` (404 for unknown ids, **409 when a song is downloading or importing** — show the problem's detail); `GET /api/v1/tag`; `/api/v1/customfilter` CRUD with `type: "library"`. The song resource now carries `tags`.

## Deliverables
- `frontend/src/api/songs.ts`: `SongFilters` gains the new filters; `useSongs` sends them; `useEditSongs()` (PUT editor; invalidates the library queries and, when move command ids come back, the commands query as the existing move modal does), `useDeleteSongs()`; `frontend/src/api/tags.ts`: `useTags()`; `frontend/src/api/customFilters.ts`: `useCustomFilters('library')`, create/update/delete hooks. Types from `frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts` (regenerated by the orchestrator before you start — if a type is missing, look at `docs/api/openapi.json`; never hand-edit `schema.d.ts`).
- Filter bar (above the table): a search box (debounced 300 ms → `term`), the existing artist select and monitored control, plus selects for library, quality profile, file (any / has file / missing), cutoff (any / met / not met) and tag (from `useTags`). Changing a filter resets to page 1. A "Clear" button resets all filters.
- Saved views: a "Views" menu listing the saved views (`useCustomFilters('library')`); choosing one applies its filters; "Save view…" opens a modal asking for a label and saves the current filters as `filters: [{ key, value, type: "equal" }]` (one entry per set filter, value as string); "Delete view" on the active one with a confirm. A view whose label already exists → show the 409 detail. The active view's label shows on the menu button.
- Selection: a checkbox column (Mantine `Checkbox`) with a header checkbox for "all on this page" (indeterminate when some); shift-click selects a range on the page. Selection is kept by song id across pages and cleared when the filters change. Extend `PagedTable` minimally (optional `selection` props) or render the checkbox column inside the page's columns — your choice, but do not break the other pages using `PagedTable`.
- Mass editor bar: when one or more songs are selected, a sticky bar shows "N selected", and actions: Monitor / Unmonitor, Quality profile (select → apply), Library (select → apply; only when there is more than one library; shows "Moving N songs…" from the returned command ids), Tags (a modal with a `TagsInput` of existing tags + new ones and a radio add / remove / replace), Delete (a confirm modal: "Delete N songs from Wondarr? Their files stay on disk."; a 409 shows which songs are still in the queue), and Clear selection. Errors from the API show in an `Alert` like the page's existing one.
- Tags on the table: a Tags column showing the song's tags as small badges (hidden when no song on the page has tags); clicking a badge filters by that tag.
- Tests (Vitest + Testing Library, following `LibraryPage.test.tsx` and the fetch mock it uses): a filter change sends the right query string and resets to page 1; selecting two rows and choosing Unmonitor sends `PUT /api/v1/song/editor` with those ids and `monitored: false`; header checkbox selects the page; shift-click range; the tags modal sends `tags` + `applyTags`; delete confirm sends `DELETE` with the ids, and a 409 shows its detail; saving a view posts the filters; choosing a saved view applies them; the Tags column hides when no song has tags.
